status: frozen BEFORE any CoT cell is generated
additive: does not overwrite PREREG_P3_SUPPLEMENT.md, p3_supp_predictions.json, or amendments 01-02
subject: generation-budget policy: 768 stays primary; 1024 is a pre-declared, conditionally-triggered sensitivity

primary.why: Consistency with the frozen GSM8K main line the P2 predictor was fitted on, and with the ten P3 No-CoT cells. posN and early_candidate are sensitive to length; changing the budget would change what the frozen features mean.
primary.cells: the four already-frozen CoT cells (llama 0/-6, qwen 0/+8)

sensitivity.status: PRE-DECLARED but CONDITIONAL -- not run unless the trigger below fires
sensitivity.never: may not replace, rescore or reinterpret the 768 primary result

why_a_single_extra_cell_is_insufficient.reason: It cannot separate a budget increase from a steering effect: with one cell there is no alpha contrast at the new budget, so any change is jointly attributable to both.
why_a_single_extra_cell_is_insufficient.complete_form: A full 1024 comparison requires a same-budget 2x2 PER MODEL: {No-CoT, CoT} x {alpha=0, alpha=workpoint}.

what_the_2x2_answers.CoT+a - CoT: does steering still add on top of CoT, at this budget
what_the_2x2_answers.NoCoT+a - NoCoT: does the original workpoint still hold at this budget
what_the_2x2_answers.difference_of_the_two: does CoT change the steering gain

staged_trigger.action: run the frozen 768 CoT cells (llama 0/-6, qwen 0/+8)

staged_trigger.trigger: llama CoT cap-hit is high enough that truncation is a live alternative explanation for the primary result
staged_trigger.note: two cells; gives a same-budget CoT alpha contrast

staged_trigger.trigger: only if the CoT interaction needs to be compared at a common budget

qwen_not_auto_included.reason: Qwen's cap-hit on GSM-Hard No-CoT is 13.3-22.7%, far below Llama's 91.3-96.0%, so truncation is not a leading explanation for Qwen.
qwen_not_auto_included.rule: Qwen gets a 1024 arm only if its own CoT cells show a comparable cap-hit problem -- not automatically, and not for symmetry.

predictor_scores_at_1024_are_exploratory.rule: Any frozen-predictor commitment score computed on 1024 output is an EXPLORATORY readout only.
predictor_scores_at_1024_are_exploratory.why: The predictor was fitted on 768-token generations. posN is a normalized position and early_candidate is a first-line rule, so both shift with the generation budget; the frozen coefficients were never calibrated for that distribution.

reporting_rule: Any 1024 result is labelled a generation-budget sensitivity, reported separately from the 768 primary, and never substituted for it. The primary claim stays 'CoT condition transfer under a fixed 768-token budget'.
